svg.title: F02-3 RACI matrix per level: CxM, CxA, EoR, GC, OEM and operations
svg.text: F02-3 RACI matrix per level: CxM, CxA, EoR, GC, OEM and operations
R responsible · A accountable · C consulted · I informed · exactly one A per row · the contractor operates the equipment, the CxA directs and records
• The OEM writes and performs the FAT; the CxA approves the procedure and witnesses; the CxM is accountable.
• Operations (DCOps) is accountable for handover acceptance and responsible for operating equipment during L5 scenarios.
F02-3 · RACI matrix per level: CxM, CxA, EoR, GC, OEM and operations
Data Centre Commissioning Field Manual R01 EN · October 2026 · educational reference, not to scale · project and OEM documents govern
